purpose: Governed MCP Hub for NosAi local-first assistance and online-to-offline learning
invariants: only explicit operator confirmation may enable network mode
no tool may expose privileged game/admin/database state
secret values are encrypted at rest and never returned by dashboard or model tools
MCP never has direct execution authority; local Guard/Safety remains final
simulation and learning persistence are side-effect free with respect to the game client
acceptance_tests: privileged and secret-export risks are denied
deterministic simulation returns identical output for identical request
candidate without observed evidence cannot become offline skill
